p4_card.identity: Proteasome-inhibitor class, research-grade or oncology agents, discussed at class level only. No named agent is proposed; formulation: UNKNOWN.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WOREE (Q230P-class) as target. Origin: a recessive missense protein in patient iPSC oligodendrocytes plus library studies (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE). This is the closest measured precedent to the Q230P premise in R1 ('normal mRNA, protein absent', partial return with an inhibitor; the transcript level is cited from an earlier report, and whether the paper examined it itself is not established), at the cost of a narrow toxicity-bounded window.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA as a test in any WWOX system (registry-based, 2026-10-20). No inhibitor arm exists in the only Q230P study.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: not verified for this disease; and exposure-or-toxicity limit shown by its own precedent (other windows toxic to controls).
p4_card.expected_contribution: Recovery of residual protein only if Q230P is lost at the proteasome; function of any recovered protein is the unanswered question.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway, not WWOX; type: blockade; direction: protein up if the variant is a proteasome substrate; context: unknown for Q230P.

for: A recessive missense protein returned from barely detectable (about 3 percent of control) to a fraction with an inhibitor, with two function-adjacent readouts on the same cells.
against: Recovery only to a fraction of control; the inhibitor also induces HSP70; specificity 'seems unlikely' by the authors' own account; toxic outside a narrow window including in controls.
A variant stabilised through the Hsp110 axis (not by proteasome blockade) that was insoluble and in which no enzyme activity could be measured (ASPA C152W).
Lysosome inhibition did nothing in the libraries; route is protein-specific.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Cell lines, few and non-isogenic; no pellet lane in the closest precedent.

not_known: Where the Q230P protein is lost: never made, made and cleared, made and insoluble, made and epitope-invisible, or truncated. No fractionation, inhibitor, synthesis or half-life datum exists for the exact variant.

Whether any recovered Q230P protein would carry WWOX function: there is no per-molecule WWOX function assay in the repository, and protein quantity does not imply function (in the R1 lot quantity and function diverged in some systems and function could not be measured in others).

The share of destabilised-missense lesions that are stability lesions for a WWOX SDR-domain variant: the estimates carried in the literature are cited estimates, and the SDR-domain thermal stability is a missing measurement.
No drug has been given to any WWOX model carrying a missense or a splice allele (known-roads note, section 5).
Whether Q230P is a proteasome substrate at all.
evidence_against: Insoluble stabilised variant with no measurable activity (ASPA C152W).
